subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should unset QMD vector/embed users inherit a 600s embed timeout by default, or should longer local-GGUF embedding remain opt-in or selectively detected?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes upgrade behavior and lock contention for existing unset configs; source review cannot decide the product tradeoff between fewer premature kills and longer high-CPU/stalled embed runs.

options.title: Require proof or narrow the default
options.body: Require redacted real QMD/GGUF embed proof plus docs alignment, or revise the branch to keep 120s as the default while adding a selective/opt-in longer budget.

options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept that all unset QMD semantic users inherit the longer embed and lock waits after upgrade.

options.title: Split warning/docs from default change
